subject: Mutual action playbook & calendarized next steps — Allegra IoT evaluation
messages:
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena@allegraiot.com>, Marco Silva <marco@allegraiot.com>, Allison Chen <allison.procure@allegraiot.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + proposed evaluation playbook (short timeline)

Hi Elena / Marco / Allison —

Great to connect earlier — thanks for walking us through Allegra's edge inference goals. Quick recap of the key items we captured and a proposed, calendarized mutual action playbook to keep momentum. Please review and flag anything we missed or mis-prioritized.

Pain points we heard
- High per-device inference cost when models are hosted in the cloud; looking to reduce per-inference spend by ~40% without sacrificing latency.
- Compliance: telemetry and logs need to be segregated per customer with 13-month audit retention.
- Burst throughput during firmware update windows; current infra can't maintain <150ms p99 for batch replays.

Goals / success criteria
- Pilot (5k devices) demonstrating sustained p99 <= 150ms and < $0.0008 per inference for edge-offload path.
- Proven audit log retention accessible to Allegra security within 30 days of request.
- Integration pattern for OTA bursts validated (auto-scaling + fallback to smaller model).

Proposed mutual action playbook (high level)
1) Technical deep-dive & data handoff (Mar 1–5): Allegra provides sampled telemetry + representative prompt set. Redwood to size config and validate latency numbers. (Owners: Allegra: Elena, Marco; Redwood: Marissa, Karthik)
2) Pilot setup & onboarding (Mar 8–19): Dedicated pilot pool (5 GPUs), KV/cache tuning, quantization profile. Deliverable: pilot runbook + cost projection. (Owners: Allegra: Ops; Redwood: Ben)
3) Pilot execution & measurement (Mar 22–Apr 5): Run 2-week load window including OTA burst simulation. Deliverable: pilot report vs success criteria.
4) Review & commercial decision (Apr 12–19): Procurement review and legal review for SLA/terms.

Asks for you today
- Confirm decision committee (names + roles) who will be involved in the Apr review.
- Share a sample telemetry export by Feb 25 (s3 link or csv) so we can pre-run tooling.
- Confirm availability for the technical deep-dive: does Mar 2 or Mar 4 work for your eng team?

Attachments: Allegra_MAP_v1.xlsx (playbook with suggested dates), Redwood_SLA-draft.pdf (placeholder SLA we discussed).

If that's aligned I will: attach a cleaned MAP, book the deep-dive slot, and loop Ben/Karthik for pricing and pilot ops.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary and the timeline. This aligns well with our stakes. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Decision committee: Allison Chen (Procurement), Javier Ortega (Head of Edge SW), Priya Nair (Security). Allison is copied in for procurement details.
2) Telemetry: we can provide an anonymized export; will aim to have a CSV upload to the s3 test bucket by Feb 24.
3) Deep-dive: Mar 4 works best for our eng squad (10–11:30 PT). Please send an invite.

Regarding the SLA: procurement will need data processing locations clarified — can Redwood confirm where logs and telemetry will be stored for a Dedicated pilot? We need the storage region to be us-west-2.

We reviewed the preliminary MAP and will look for the committed cost estimate you mentioned.

Best,

Elena Rossi

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Recap + proposed evaluation playbook (Allegra) — pricing + pilot ops needed

Ben / Karthik —

Rolling this thread up. Elena confirmed decision committee and picked Mar 4 for a 90-min deep-dive. They promised telemetry upload by Feb 24. Key asks for us:
- Ben: can you draft a pilot pricing snapshot (5k devices equivalent) including Dedicated pool pricing, expected token rates, estimated committed vs burst costs, and any recommended buffer for OTA windows? Please include a simple PO/commit template we can hand to Allison.
- Karthik: please prepare the pilot runbook skeleton (hardware footprint, quantization profiles recommended, data ingestion checklist) and a short note on where logs will be stored by default; Allegra requested us-west-2 for pilot storage.

Goal: have both artifacts by EOD Feb 25 so I can attach them to the MAP and send to Allegra before their procurement review.

Thanks —
Marissa
